english.title: Loiter in the Blackwall / Silvertown Tunnel areas when asked to leave by an authorised person
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), loitered in the

(A)_[Blackwall]
(B)_[Silvertown]

tunnel area, when asked to leave by an authorised person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 6(2) of the Blackwall and Silvertown Tunnels Byelaws 2018 and article 48(6) of the Silvertown Tunnel Order 2018.
